quarterly_data.quarter: OpenAI press release: OpenAI acquires Orchestra Bio (10-20-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: OpenAI has acquired Orchestra Bio, a platform that helps biopharma teams coordinate drug development (people and AI agents tracking studies and campaigns); its team and technology join Rosalind, OpenAI's AI models and tools for life sciences research (GPT-Rosalind, Rosalind Workbench), with the aim of building agents that connect scientific findings with the studies, decisions and next steps needed to advance a potential medicine.
